commands.command:
bash -s <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
set -euo pipefail
base=/srv/legacy2/filename-encoding-migration
src=$base/imported
dst=$base/converted
report=$base/collision-report.txt

if [[ -e $report || -L $report ]]; then
  printf 'Refusing to replace existing report: %q\n' "$report" >&2
  exit 1
fi

tmp=$(mktemp "$base/.collision-report.XXXXXX")
trap 'rm -f -- "$tmp"' EXIT
chmod 0644 "$tmp"
printf 'Filename conversion collision report\nSource encoding: ISO-8859-1\nDestination encoding: UTF-8\n\n' > "$tmp"

copied=0
collisions=0
errors=0

# Materialize the converted directory hierarchy before copying leaf objects.
while IFS= read -r -d '' source_path; do
  rel=${source_path#"$src"/}
  utf8_rel=$(printf '%s' "$rel" | iconv -f ISO-8859-1 -t UTF-8)
  target=$dst/$utf8_rel
  if [[ -e $target || -L $target ]]; then
    if [[ ! -d $target ]]; then
      printf 'COLLISION source=%q destination=%q reason=destination-exists-and-is-not-directory\n' "$rel" "$utf8_rel" >> "$tmp"
      ((collisions+=1))
    fi
  else
    mkdir -p -- "$target"
  fi
done < <(find "$src" -mindepth 1 -type d -print0)

while IFS= read -r -d '' source_path; do
  rel=${source_path#"$src"/}
  utf8_rel=$(printf '%s' "$rel" | iconv -f ISO-8859-1 -t UTF-8)
  target=$dst/$utf8_rel
  parent=${target%/*}
  if [[ -e $target || -L $target ]]; then
    printf 'COLLISION source=%q destination=%q reason=destination-exists\n' "$rel" "$utf8_rel" >> "$tmp"
    printf 'COLLISION: %q -> %q (preserved existing destination)\n' "$rel" "$utf8_rel"
    ((collisions+=1))
    continue
  fi
  if [[ ! -d $parent ]]; then
    printf 'ERROR source=%q destination=%q reason=parent-directory-unavailable\n' "$rel" "$utf8_rel" >> "$tmp"
    ((errors+=1))
    continue
  fi
  cp -a -- "$source_path" "$target"
  printf 'COPIED: %q -> %q\n' "$rel" "$utf8_rel"
  ((copied+=1))
done < <(find "$src" -mindepth 1 ! -type d -print0)

printf '\nSummary: copied=%d collisions=%d errors=%d\n' "$copied" "$collisions" "$errors" >> "$tmp"
mv -- "$tmp" "$report"
trap - EXIT
printf 'SUMMARY copied=%d collisions=%d errors=%d report=%s\n' "$copied" "$collisions" "$errors" "$report"
[[ $errors -eq 0 ]]
ANTRIEB_EOF

COPIED: $'caf\351.txt' -> café.txt
COLLISION: plain.txt -> plain.txt (preserved existing destination)
COPIED: $'r\351sum\351.txt' -> résumé.txt

commands.command:
bash -s <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
set -euo pipefail
base=/srv/legacy2/filename-encoding-migration
src=$base/imported
dst=$base/converted

printf '%s\n' '--- SOURCE PRESERVATION ---'
expected_source_hashes=(
  59f6d353275a6146b3b03834424fb0cad6fece8b4034ecab9f89da4109efa243
  0e114029a06a60a7ae6c677b208479866bafeecee1712c4100b06805bfdc63b4
  9712e6ef87b39863c66daff1d948f4e0f6684f290a2882ba9eb6780b9e6ed51f
)
idx=0
while IFS= read -r -d '' p; do
  hash=$(sha256sum -- "$p" | cut -d' ' -f1)
  printf 'SOURCE path=%q sha256=%s\n' "${p#"$src"/}" "$hash"
  [[ $hash == "${expected_source_hashes[$idx]}" ]]
  ((idx+=1))
done < <(find "$src" -type f -print0 | sort -z)
[[ $idx -eq 3 ]]

printf '%s\n' '--- UTF-8 DESTINATIONS AND CONTENT EQUALITY ---'
copied=0
collided=0
while IFS= read -r -d '' p; do
  rel=${p#"$src"/}
  utf8_rel=$(printf '%s' "$rel" | iconv -f ISO-8859-1 -t UTF-8)
  target=$dst/$utf8_rel
  if [[ $rel == plain.txt ]]; then
    [[ -f $target ]]
    [[ $(sha256sum -- "$target" | cut -d' ' -f1) == 6b72446745ee7a234b08fe338eff93f718d7964918327d2d468fccf110940da8 ]]
    if cmp -s -- "$p" "$target"; then
      printf 'unexpected overwrite of collision target\n' >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    printf 'COLLISION-PRESERVED source=%q destination=%q destination_sha256=%s\n' "$rel" "$utf8_rel" "$(sha256sum -- "$target" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
    ((collided+=1))
  else
    [[ -f $target ]]
    printf '%s' "$utf8_rel" | iconv -f UTF-8 -t UTF-8 >/dev/null
    cmp -- "$p" "$target"
    printf 'CONTENT-MATCH source=%q destination=%q sha256=%s\n' "$rel" "$utf8_rel" "$(sha256sum -- "$target" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
    ((copied+=1))
  fi
done < <(find "$src" -type f -print0 | sort -z)
[[ $copied -eq 2 && $collided -eq 1 ]]

printf '%s\n' '--- DESTINATION TREE (BYTE-UNAMBIGUOUS) ---'
while IFS= read -r -d '' p; do
  rel=${p#"$dst"/}
  printf '%s' "$rel" | iconv -f UTF-8 -t UTF-8 >/dev/null
  printf 'DEST path=%q sha256=%s\n' "$rel" "$(sha256sum -- "$p" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
done < <(find "$dst" -type f -print0 | sort -z)

printf '%s\n' '--- COLLISION REPORT ---'
cat "$base/collision-report.txt"
[[ ! -e $base/.collision-report.* ]]
printf 'VERIFIED source_files=%d copied_content_matches=%d preserved_collisions=%d\n' "$idx" "$copied" "$collided"
ANTRIEB_EOF
